Sunset on Seawalk is a stunning gulf front home professionally managed by Beach Habitats 30A and comes with a 6 seat golf cart and 5 bikes. 4 chairs, two umbrellas and two tables are provided from 3/1-10/31 on your private dedicated beach. All adjacent construction is complete.

Discover unparalleled coastal luxury at Sunset on Seawalk, a breathtaking 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom gulf-front home in the serene community of Seagrove Beach, Florida. Professionally managed by Beach Habitats 30A, this completely remodeled retreat sleeps up to 11 guests and boasts direct private gated beach access, making it the ideal spot for family vacations, romantic getaways, or group escapes along Florida's iconic Scenic Highway 30A. Enjoy exclusive perks like a 6-seat golf cart for easy neighborhood cruising, 5 complimentary bikes for exploring the Timpoochee Trail, and seasonal beach setup (4 chairs, 2 umbrellas, and 2 tables provided from March 1 to October 31) on your dedicated private stretch of sugar-white sand. Rest easy knowing all adjacent construction is complete—nothing but uninterrupted views and tranquility await.

Why Choose Sunset on Seawalk? Top Features for an Unforgettable 30A Vacation.

Spectacular Gulf-Front Location: Wake up to panoramic ocean views and step directly onto the beach via your private gated path. Perfect for sunrise strolls, shell collecting, or evening bonfires under the stars—Seagrove's pristine shores are your backyard.
Private Outdoor Haven: Lounge by the elevated heated swimming pool, host barbecues in the fully equipped outdoor kitchen with grill and seating, and soak in the coastal breeze. This setup is designed for al fresco dining, poolside relaxation, and creating lasting memories.

Modern Luxury Amenities: Fresh from a top-tier remodel by an acclaimed design team, the home features high-end finishes, gourmet indoor kitchen with premium appliances, smart TVs throughout, high-speed Wi-Fi, full laundry facilities, and ample parking. Linens, towels, and starter supplies are included for a hassle-free arrival.

Family and Group-Friendly Design: With ensuite bathrooms in every bedroom, multiple balconies for private retreats, and open spaces for gatherings, this home offers both intimacy and room to roam. Ideal for multi-generational families or friends—sleeps 11 comfortably without feeling crowded.

Eco and Adventure Perks: Seagrove Beach embraces a bike-friendly, walkable vibe with a focus on sustainability. Use your included golf cart and bikes to minimize your footprint while maximizing fun.

Detailed Home Layout: Comfort and Elegance on Every Level

This multi-level gulf-front masterpiece spans three floors, blending seamless indoor-outdoor living with stunning views from nearly every room. Here's the breakdown:

First Floor:

Bedroom 1: Cozy queen bed with premium linens, flat-screen TV, and ensuite bathroom for main-level privacy.
Living, Dining & Kitchen: Expansive open-concept area with abundant natural light, designer furnishings, large flat-screen TV, and a gourmet kitchen stocked with high-end appliances, cookware, and essentials. Dining seats up to 8-10 comfortably.
Additional Features: Convenient half bathroom and full laundry room.
Outdoor Paradise: Access the outdoor kitchen, heated raised pool, and your private gated beach path—steps from the living area for effortless indoor-outdoor flow.

Second Floor:

Bedroom 2: King bed, flat-screen TV, and ensuite bathroom—perfect for guests seeking ocean vistas.
Bedroom 3 (Second Master): Luxurious king bed, flat-screen TV, and spa-like ensuite bathroom.
Bedroom 4 (Bunk Room): Fun setup with one twin-over-twin bunk bed (sleeps 2) and one separate twin bed (total of 3), flat-screen TV, and ensuite bathroom with bathtub—great for kids or teens.
Balcony Bliss: A massive balcony spans the entire front of the home, offering sweeping gulf views for morning coffee or sunset cocktails.

Third Floor:

Master Suite (Entire Floor): Ultimate privacy with a king bed, flat-screen TV, ensuite bathroom featuring a soaking tub and walk-in shower, plus a massive private balcony with unobstructed ocean panoramas. Enjoy added luxuries like a coffee bar and refrigerator drawers—your personal sanctuary for recharging.

All bedrooms include ceiling fans, blackout curtains, and plush mattresses for restful sleep, while the home's 4,000+ square feet ensure everyone has space to unwind.

Explore Seagrove Beach and the Best Things to Do on 30A:
Seagrove Beach is the epitome of laid-back Florida coastal living, nestled between vibrant neighbors like Seaside, Watercolor, and Grayton Beach. With its rare coastal dune lakes, state parks, and endless outdoor adventures, it's a paradise for nature lovers, foodies, and families. Conveniently located, you're just about 1 mile east of iconic Seaside (a quick 5-minute bike ride or golf cart trip), approximately 2 miles to the upscale Watercolor community (10-15 minutes by bike along the scenic trail), and roughly 4 miles to charming Grayton Beach (a leisurely 20-minute drive or bike adventure). This prime positioning means you can easily hop between these hotspots via the 19-mile Timpoochee Trail, enjoying seamless access to their unique attractions without the hassle of long commutes. Here's a curated guide to the top activities and attractions—many just a short bike or golf cart ride away:

Beach Bliss and Water Sports: Spend days on Seagrove's world-famous white-sand beaches swimming, sunbathing, or beachcombing. Rent paddleboards or kayaks to explore Eastern Lake, one of 30A's unique coastal dune lakes—perfect for eco-tours or serene paddling. For thrills, try stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) or snorkeling in the clear Gulf waters.
Biking and Hiking Adventures: Hop on your complimentary bikes and cruise the 19-mile Timpoochee Trail, a scenic path paralleling 30A with stops at charming towns, art galleries, and viewpoints. Hike through Point Washington State Forest for shaded trails, wildlife spotting, and birdwatching—ideal for all ages.

Family Fun at The Big Chill: Head to this lively hub for kid-friendly entertainment, including outdoor movies, live music, arcade games, mini-golf, and a splash pad. Grab casual eats from food trucks or shops—great for a full day of play.
Dining Delights: Indulge in Seagrove's culinary scene with fresh seafood at Old Florida Fish House (overlooking Eastern Lake), upscale meals at Café Thirty-A or Surfing Deer, or casual bites at Seagrove Village Market Café and Steamboat Grill. For families, try Angelina's Pizzeria or kid-approved spots like The Perfect Pig in nearby Santa Rosa Beach. Don't miss happy hours and beachside bonfires for s'mores and stories.

Shopping and Culture: Browse boutiques like 30A General Store for souvenirs and beachwear, or Clay 30A for garden pottery and plants. Visit the Underwater Museum of Art (UMA) off Grayton Beach for an underwater sculpture dive, or explore Seaside's amphitheater for free concerts and events.

Nearby Excursions: Venture to Grayton Beach State Park (just 4 miles away) for camping, fishing, and picnics; Eden Gardens State Park for historic gardens; or the shops and food trucks in Seaside (only 1 mile west). Watercolor, a mere 2 miles away, offers additional resort-style amenities like fine dining and spa experiences. Year-round festivals, yoga on the beach, and eco-adventures like dolphin cruises keep the excitement going.
Relaxation and Wellness: Practice yoga on the sand, book a spa day, or simply toast the sunset from your balcony—Seagrove's tranquil vibe is perfect for recharging.

With its mix of adventure and serenity, Seagrove Beach offers endless ways to create memories, from bonfire nights to trail explorations—all within easy reach of your gulf-front home.
Ready for your slice of paradise? Book Sunset on Seawalk today for the ultimate Seagrove Beach vacation rental on 30A—competitive rates, flexible stays, and seasonal specials available. Contact Beach Habitats 30A for seamless booking and 24/7 support. Your gulf-front dream getaway starts here!
